title: Help counts model calls while the provider first response is pending
steps: S1: start two Help requests with a scripted model that holds its first response.
S2: send a third Help request for the same account before releasing either response.
S3: release the first responses and finish the pending requests.
expect: S1: two calls reach the scripted model and hold two stream slots.
S2: the third request receives HTTP 429 BUSY without reaching the model.
S3: the first two requests complete and release their slots.
evidence: On the dev web source commit, the route incremented the local stream count only after the provider's first response. A local test reproduced a third call starting while two first responses were held.
fence: A provider call owns a per-account slot throughout its pending first response and releases it on every exit.

tests: Help reserves a stream slot while waiting for the provider first response
